messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "store away from children"
set: ["store away from children", "store in dry place away from moisture", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light", "store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, or cold temperatures", "stay away from sick people", "store tightly closed at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light", "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "keep away from heat and light", "store at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C) away from moisture and heat", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "store brand", "children from birth to less than 18 years of age", "store in original bottle", "protect from light", "store in a dry place"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
